name: iubenda
summary: Compliance platform for websites and apps: cookie consent banner with consent log, generated privacy, cookie and terms documents, and Google Consent Mode, priced per site by pageviews.
best_for: website owners and small businesses in the EU and elsewhere that want a cookie banner, consent records and generated privacy and cookie policies in one subscription
skip_if: you run many sites and do not qualify for agency pricing, you need a Shopify-only consent app, or your legal team writes and hosts its own policies
honest_knock: Prices are per site, and each plan has a pageview quota (25K, 50K or 150K a month) with €0.05 per 1,000 above it. Essentials allows one language and up to 20 policy clauses; multilingual sites start on Advanced at €19.99 a month. The free plan's limits are not on the pricing page. We have not used iubenda ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials · per site per month billed yearly, excl
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 on iubenda.com/en/pricing, browser render plus the page source for the monthly and USD figures; prices exclude VAT) All plans are priced per site per month; yearly billing saves 16%. Essentials is €4.99 billed yearly or €5.99 monthly ($5.99 / $6.99) for up to 25K pageviews, a standard privacy and cookie policy with up to 20 clauses, one language, partial branding removal and monthly site scans. Advanced, marked most popular, is €19.99 yearly or €21.99 monthly ($24.99 / $27.99) for up to 50K pageviews, complete legal documents with up to 30 clauses, all languages and geo-targeting. Ultimate is €79.99 yearly or €89.99 monthly ($99.99 / $119.99) for up to 150K pageviews, unlimited clauses, full branding removal, hourly scans, a mobile SDK, detailed analytics and consent recovery. Above the quota every plan pays €0.05 per 1,000 extra pageviews. Forms proof of consent and the newsletter opt-in booster are €5 a month per 1,000 consents. A free plan exists (its limits are not on the pricing page), every paid plan can be tried for 14 days, and agency and enterprise plans are quoted separately. Accessibility plans are a separate product, from €6 per site a month for up to 10K pageviews.
